===Notable Locations===
* [[Tai Bwo Wannai]] - Requires 100 [[Trading sticks]] to enter, but completion of the [[Elite Karamja Diary]] permits free access. The nearby Tai Bwo Wannai Parcel Service can transport logs to your bank for 10 trading sticks each.
* [[Tlati Rainforest]] - Able to obtain [[Ent seed]] and [[Loop half of key (moon key)]] drops.
* [[Prifddinas]] - Able to receive [[Crystal shard]] drops.
